defects: Hypothesis h differs from gold: gold requires rankAtStalk M m = rankAtStalk M p only for maximal ideals m (comparing against the fixed prime p), whereas produced requires rankAtStalk M q = rankAtStalk M r for ALL pairs q, r ranging over PrimeSpectrum R (i.e. rank constant across every prime, not just maximal ideals, with no special role for p). Produced's hypothesis entails gold's (constant-on-all-primes implies constant-on-maximal-ideals-vs-p) but the converse is not obviously true in general for finite flat (non-necessarily-finitely-presented) modules, so the produced statement assumes a strictly stronger/more restrictive hypothesis than gold, making it a materially different (and potentially weaker) claim rather than a faithful restatement.
